items.summary_zh: 9月6日， 中国人寿 集团宣布，财政部将向 中国人寿 保险（集团）公司注资350亿元，进一步增强 中国人寿 稳健经营和风险抵御能力，为公司专注主业、完善治理、错位发展注入动力

items.title: Another incident: a batch of OpenAI agents in the US was exposed hijacking a German website to exchange methods for bypassing restrictions
items.title_zh: 又出事了！美国一批OpenAI智能体，被曝劫持了一个德国网站，用来相互传递突破限制的方法！
items.summary: As it releases its most powerful model to date, GPT-6, OpenAI is caught up in another AI-agent safety controversy.
items.summary_zh: 发布迄今最强模型GPT-6之际，OpenAI又卷入一起AI智能体安全争议

items.title: ICBC plans to raise up to RMB 100bn and ABC up to RMB 160bn to replenish capital
items.title_zh: 工行拟募资不超过1000亿元、农行拟募资不超过1600亿元用于补充资本
items.summary: On Sept 6, ICBC announced a proposed private placement of A shares to the Ministry of Finance of China, China National Tobacco Corporation and its related subsidiaries, planning to raise no more than RMB 100bn, which after deducting issuance expenses will be used entirely to replenish core tier-1 capital.
items.summary_zh: 9月6日，中国 工商银行 公告称，拟向特定对象发行A股股票，发行对象为中华人民共和国财政部、中国烟草总公司及相关子公司，计划募集资金不超过1000亿元，募集资金扣除相关发行费用后拟全部用于补充核心一级资本

items.title: Big Tech interview question for AI product managers: how do you build an evaluation standard for a towel
items.title_zh: 大厂对AI产品经理的面试题：如何对毛巾建立评价标准
items.summary: Meta vice president Jagjit Chawla revealed in a recent podcast that he screens AI product managers with a write-a-bath-towel-evaluation exercise, the point being to test a candidate ability to build multi-dimensional evaluation criteria.
items.summary_zh: Meta副总裁Jagjit Chawla在最新播客中透露，他用“写一份浴巾评估”来筛选AI产品经理，核心是考察候选人建立多维度评估标准的能力

items.title: CTA short positioning in G10 rates hits record extremes, with German bunds the largest concentration of shorts
items.title_zh: CTA做空G10利率创历史极值，德国国债成最大空头集中地
items.summary: According to Vanda latest CTA fixed-income positioning data, trend-following funds are now short major G10 government bond futures across the board, with German bund short exposure the most pronounced: 10-year, 30-year and 5-year bunds are all at extreme levels.
items.summary_zh: 根据 Vanda 最新的 CTA 固定收益仓位数据，趋势跟踪型资金目前已全面做空 G10 主要国债期货，其中德国国债的空头敞口最为突出，10年期、30年期和5年期德债均处于极端水平

items.title: Nolan: my interest in the universe far exceeds my interest in AI
items.title_zh: 诺兰：我对宇宙的兴趣远超AI
items.summary: Nolan said outright in a recent podcast that space exploration fascinates him far more than earthbound technologies such as AI, because it better fires the human imagination and passion for the unknown.
items.summary_zh: 诺兰在近期的播客节目中直言，宇宙探索远比AI等地球技术更让他着迷，因为那更能激发人类对未知的想象与热情

items.title: Typos in the first interim report under the new chairman spark heated debate; Zijin Mining announces in the early hours that it made an error, issues a correction and apologises sincerely
items.title_zh: “人民币政府”“新熊源”？新董事长上任后首份半年报出现差错引热议，紫金矿业凌晨公告：写错了，更正并诚挚致歉
items.summary: In the early hours of Sept 6, Zijin Mining issued a correction announcement stating that the names of three entities in the notes to principal items of the consolidated financial statements section of its 2026 interim report and earlier announcements contained textual errors; the names in those documents are corrected to Mozhugongka County People's Government, Qinghai Xining Rural Commercial Bank Co Ltd and Jiangsu Zangqing New Energy Industry Development Fund Partnership (Limited Partnership).
items.summary_zh: 9月6日凌晨，紫金矿业发布更正公告称，近期公司披露的《2026年半年度报告》及前期公告中“合并财务报表主要项目注释”部分3家单位的名称出现文字错误，现将上述披露文件中所涉3家单位出错名称更正为“墨竹工卡县人民政府”“青海西宁农村商业银行股份有限公司”“江苏藏青新能源产业发展基金合伙企业（有限合伙）”

items.title: Weekend headlines round-up: seven ministries set out their latest plans on artificial intelligence and computing infrastructure
items.title_zh: 周末要闻汇总：事关人工智能、算力设施等 七部门最新部署
items.summary: Key market-moving news this weekend: seven ministries issue their latest deployment on artificial intelligence and computing infrastructure; US Trade Representative Greer says China and the US may issue a statement on agriculture and related non-tariff barriers, with a response from the foreign ministry; the central bank will conduct a RMB 500bn outright reverse repo operation on Sept 7; US August payrolls beat expectations by a wide margin, lifting Fed rate-hike expectations; the US and Iran struck each other tankers and the Iranian military says larger strikes on the US may follow; the first industry rules governing private-fund raising are published.
items.summary_zh: 本周末影响市场的重要资讯有：事关 人工智能 、算力设施等，七部门最新部署；美国贸易代表格里尔称中美或将就农业及相关非关税壁垒发布声明，外交部回应；央行9月7日将开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作；美国8月非农数据大超预期，美联储加息预期升温；美伊互袭油轮，伊朗军方称或对美进行更大规模打击；首个针对私募募集的行业规范出台，
